name: Arnaud Delorme
abstract_title: Exploring the Mechanisms of Biofield Therapy Through Joint Electrophysiological Recordings in Humans and Mice
abstract: In this case study, a self-described biofield therapy (BT) therapist and a sham therapist participated in multiple (n=24) treatment and control (non-treatment) sessions under double-blind conditions. During the treatment phases, BT and sham therapists attempted to influence mice with cancer and control mice, alternating BT with rest phases where no such efforts were made.
